manifest.name: Reference: Library Pack
manifest.description: Adds a Library section, three reusable Script nodes, a Generic Collection and a runnable workflow template. The deployed nodes keep working when the plugin is off.
manifest.author: AgentSys reference plugins

collections.name: pack-notes
collections.title: Library pack notes
collections.description: Notes written by the reference Library Pack nodes.

library.name: Pack: Slug
library.description: Turns text into a URL slug. No client or plugin is needed after deployment.
library.code:
const text = String(node.input.text ?? node.input.value ?? '');
node.output.slug = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');

library.name: Pack: Greeting
library.description: Displays a greeting and returns it.

library.name: Pack: Record note
library.description: Stores a note in the pack-notes Generic Collection through the ordinary API.
